changelog:
Initial release of cinematic-video skill

- Generates cinematic-style videos featuring deliberate framing, camera motion, lighting, and color grading.
- Supports both text-to-video and image-to-video workflows, adapting the approach based on user inputs and prompts.
- Integrates with top video generation models: Google Veo 3.1 (w/ audio), Luma Ray 3.2 (HDR support), and Runway Gen-4.5 (locked look).
- Uses a compact cinematic prompt scaffold to direct shot language and camera vocabulary.
- Polled, asynchronous video generation workflow for reliable delivery and quality control.
- Includes clear guidelines for model parameter selection, prompt phrasing, and quality standards.
summary: Make video that looks shot, not generated, with deliberate framing, lens, camera motion, lighting, and color grade. Use when the user says "cinematic clip",...
